welcome.title: 🧠 BrainRecall — lasting knowledge and atomic habits
welcome.body: Turn what you read into durable knowledge using 5 evidence-based learning methods and build resilient habits with Streak Freeze protection. • Free forever: manual mode, 3 topics, 3 habits, up to 500 items, and meaning groups. • 7-day free trial: AI file import (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, TXT) and AI answer grading — starts only on your first AI action.

help.title: ❓ BrainRecall Help
help.body: • How it works: We combine 5 cognitive methods: retrieval practice (M1), spaced practice (M2), interleaved practice (M3), self-explanation (M4), and concept relations (M5). • Free plan: Free forever for manual use with up to 3 active topics and 3 habits. • Payments & Subscriptions: Powered by Telegram Stars. For billing help, use /paysupport or open Help inside the app.

paysupport.title: 💳 Payments & Telegram Stars Support
paysupport.body: All subscriptions (Start — 499 ⭐, Pro — 1,099 ⭐) and Streak Freeze purchases use official Telegram Stars billing. • You can cancel auto-renewal anytime on the Subscription screen (D28) inside the Mini App. • After cancellation, your current paid period remains active until its expiration date. • If a charge failed or you need a Stars refund, open Help & Support (D33) or reply to this message and we will verify your telegram_payment_charge_id.

d01.hero_title: Remember what you read. Stick to what you do.
d01.hero_subtitle: 5 peer-reviewed cognitive learning methods + an atomic habit tracker with 2-minute minimums and Streak Freeze protection.
d01.section_problem_title: Why do we forget most of what we read within a week?
d01.section_problem_desc: Rereading and highlighting create an illusion of competence: the text feels familiar while it is in front of you, but cannot be retrieved when needed.
d01.section_demo_title: Live Demo: experience the testing effect
d01.demo_card_text: Actively retrieving an idea from memory strengthens neural retrieval routes far more effectively than rereading the same passage multiple times.
d01.demo_prompt: Why does retrieval practice outperform rereading after a week, even when your first recall attempt feels harder?
d01.demo_placeholder: Write 1–2 sentences in your own words or test yourself aloud…
d01.demo_rubric_1: Mentions active retrieval from memory without looking at the source
d01.demo_rubric_2: Notes the fluency/familiarity illusion caused by passive rereading
d01.demo_rubric_3: Concludes that retrieval strengthens long-term retention over days/weeks
d01.section_science_subtitle: Tap any method to inspect the experimental results, boundary conditions, and primary DOIs (D42).
d01.habits_feature_1_desc: Too exhausted for a full workout or book chapter? Complete your minimum viable action to keep your identity and streak intact.
d01.habits_feature_2_desc: Hold up to 2 single-day freezes: get 1 starter freeze on your first earned day + 1 free freeze every 7 earned days.
d01.pricing_free_desc: Free forever: 3 topics, 3 habits, up to 500 active items, all 5 methods and meaning groups manually.
d01.pricing_trial_desc: Starts only on your first AI operation: 30,000 import tokens, 20 AI checks, 5 AI cases, 1 AI habit plan.
d01.pricing_start_desc: 10 topics, 10 habits, 10,000 items, 200,000 import tokens, 200 AI checks, 20 cases, 5 habit plans, 4 AI weekly reviews.
d01.pricing_pro_desc: 50 topics, 30 habits, 30,000 items, 600,000 import tokens, 1,000 AI checks, 100 cases, 20 habit plans, 4 AI weekly reviews.
d01.faq_1_q: Do I have to pay upfront or link a credit card?
d01.faq_1_a: No. Manual mode is free forever. The 7-day AI trial is free and starts only when you explicitly confirm your first AI file import or AI check.
d01.faq_2_q: What happens to my items if my subscription expires?
d01.faq_2_a: Nothing is deleted! You choose 3 active topics and 3 active habits to continue practicing, while everything else stays readable and exportable.
d01.faq_3_q: Where do the 80% and 33–36% numbers come from?
d01.faq_3_a: They come from Roediger & Karpicke (2006) for 1-week delayed retention of prose passages. Every method sheet (D42) lists the exact study scope and DOIs.
